artworks.title: Bather
artworks.medium: colored chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows flowing and curved lines forming an abstract composition resembling a human figure in a seated or reclining position. The lines are in black, accented with vibrant orange, purple, and green colors. Purple lines form an abstract shape above the figure, while orange and purple accents below suggest shapes resembling a flame or leaf.

artworks.title: Jaguar
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: The Curtain
artworks.medium: pastel over charcoal and monotype on laid paper mounted on board
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: At least three men in black suits, one wearing a top hat, and a ballerina wearing a white costume, all stand among a theater set with a painted, partially raised backdrop across the background in this nearly square pastel over a monotype print on paper. The scene is loosely drawn so many details are difficult to make out. The man we see the most of is shown from the ankles up, standing near the lower right corner of the composition. He faces away from us with his hands in his pockets. The ballerina stands facing our right next to him, and she is cut off by the right edge of the composition. She has pale skin and dark hair, and a black ribbon is tied around her neck. She wears a knee-length white tutu with a crimson-red sash tied around the waist of the white bodice. One pink leg raised parallel to the ground disappears behind the man in black. The stage beneath them is streaked with sand brown and pale gray. A tree trunk and branches leans into the scene from the upper right corner. Part of a stage set painted with mostly straw yellow with touches of mint green screens off the view to our left. Two sets of black suit pants show that a pair of men stand behind it, facing the back of the stage. One of them rests his hand on a cane. The backdrop across the back is painted with greenery below a blue sky. In a gap between the lower edge of the backdrop and the stage, about ten pairs of legs, clad either in pink stockings with white shoes or brown stockings with yellow shoes, are visible from the thighs down. One more pair of black, trouser-covered legs stand with feet planted at hip width, to our right. The artist signed the work in black letters near the lower left corner, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Study of Arabs
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals in a loose, interpretive style, primarily focusing on their upper bodies. They appear to be standing or sitting in relaxed poses. The facial features are minimally suggested, with some figures having more defined features like beards or lighter facial tones. All individuals wear turbans on their heads. Their clothing is loose and flowing, resembling robes in light colors like white or beige, with some featuring darker drapes across their shoulders. One figure has a hint of a red and blue design on the robe. The background is a neutral sepia tone without distinct environmental details.

artworks.title: A Breton Gleaner
artworks.medium: pastel on laid paper, squared in blue pastel
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image captures a person from above, seated or crouching. The figure is bending forward, with their head bowed down and turned towards the ground on the left side of the frame. The facial features are not visible due to the angle, and the head is covered by what appears to be a cap or cloth. The person's hair is partially visible, likely dark and matching the outfit. They wear a long sleeve garment in shades of green and blue, with parts of it extending around them. One hand is reaching towards the ground. The background is plain, drawing focus to the figure.

artworks.title: The Railway Restaurant
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper laid down
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring a group of people engaged in various activities. At least four individuals are visible from the waist up. The central figure, a man, is wearing a top hat, and a woman standing close to him also wears a hat. Their facial features are lightly sketched. The figures surrounding them also wear hats. The individuals are dressed in formal attire. In the lower foreground is a table with the outline of a glass and a plate. The background has vertical lines that may represent fencing or a railing, along with some sketches of text or signage. The entire scene is in a monochromatic tone, giving it a vintage sketch appearance.

artworks.title: Le Bruit de deux sabots trainant...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a complex, multi-layered etching with architectural silhouettes, a figure with an umbrella, and spires in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated and the etching features delicate lines and varying shading intensities. The color palette is monochrome with blacks, whites, and grays. Close to us, a person with an umbrella is reflected in a wet surface. Surrounding the central scene are various figures and sketches, creating a chaotic border. The piece balances darkness and light, intricacy, and simplicity.

artworks.title: Le Soir meme..
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bridge scene with sketches surrounding it. The central image shows a group of figures crossing a stone bridge, with some holding umbrellas or banners. Additional figures are present under the arches of the bridge. Around the central image are various sketches of playful creatures, figures, and decorative elements. The style is intricate with fine lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: A cette lueur soudaine...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with a fortified gate. Various figures and animals are depicted around the gate. In the forefront, a bull is charging through the street. The background shows tall stone structures of a fortified town. The margins of the drawing are embellished with intricate sketches, possibly featuring human figures and mythological creatures. The entire composition is detailed and rendered in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: A cette lueur soudaine...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene at a fortress. The drawing features a monochrome image depicting figures and horses in motion around an imposing fortress with towers and battlements. Flags fly atop one of the towers, and the sense of motion and activity is evident from the dynamic posture of the horses and figures. The architecture suggests medieval or early Renaissance style, evoking a scene of a siege or a significant event. The artwork is highly detailed despite its small size and uses a single color palette for a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Je fis ce qu'on appelle un bon marche.
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The composition portrays a busy street with various activities. Animals are running through the street, causing frenzy among the crowd. Tall buildings surround the scene. In the foreground, there are detailed figures engaged in the chaos. The drawing includes decorative elements along the borders. The style of the etching is dynamic, with sharp lines and expressive features.

artworks.title: Je fis ce qu'on appelle un bon marche..
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The drawing depicts a city street bustling with activity in a monochromatic reddish-orange tone. Several buildings line the street, with one featuring a decorative sign. In the background, a Gothic-style cathedral looms over the surroundings. The street is crowded with various creatures and carriages, creating a sense of motion. The drawing is detailed, capturing the architecture and dynamics of the scene.

artworks.title: On allume des cierges...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting a detailed, surreal scene framed by intricate drawings. The perspective is from ground level, offering a straight-on view. In the central scene, a pathway lined with jagged trees leads to a sun on the horizon. The etching style uses fine lines and hatching to create texture and shadow for the landscape and tree silhouettes. The frame surrounding the central scene features whimsical sketches of creatures and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, contrasting black ink with the pale background paper.

artworks.title: On allume le cierges...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a surreal scene on a vertical surface with figures climbing a ladder. The image is set against a textured, slightly abstracted background with a natural setting, possibly by the sea. A series of figures are ascending a narrow, precarious ladder that climbs up the side of an edifice. The entire scene is depicted in a monochromatic red tone, which casts a dramatic mood. The background presents a rippling surface reminiscent of waves, and the sun is half-visible on the horizon. The drawing suggests a dreamlike quality.

artworks.title: La Diligence de Beaucaire
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central image of a horse-drawn carriage in an elaborate setting. Surrounding it are smaller sketches of figures in historical attire and possibly mythical creatures. There is also a portrait in an ornate frame at the bottom center and a theatrical scene with musical instruments and stylized masks. The overall composition suggests a narrative with drama and nostalgia, likely in a fantasy or romantic style.

artworks.title: La Cure de Cucagnan
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features intricate lines and soft gradients forming an abstract composition. At the center, a framed rectangular section shows a scene resembling a gathering, with figures seated or standing around a larger figure. This central section is surrounded by a border filled with abstract shapes and sketches, including heraldic dragons and robed figures. The border contains elements that suggest structures like an ancient cathedral, a grave with a cross, and dragons.

artworks.title: Le Soir meme..
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures and animals on a bridge. The image shows silhouettes of people and animals crossing a bridge. The figures are in mid-motion, some are holding an umbrella and others are gesturing. Beneath the bridge, archways can be seen with indications of plants or trees. The style is reminiscent of 18th or 19th-century sketch work with simple lines, highlighting movement and travel. The illustration is in a reddish hue.

artworks.title: Le Bruit de deux sabots trainant...
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features a sketch in warm orange on a pale canvas. The scene shows architectural silhouettes on the horizon, including a tall spire and a cross. In the foreground, a figure leaps with an umbrella over their head, casting a reflection in water. The brushstrokes are soft and textural, suggesting movement and vibrancy, especially in the depiction of rain. The monochrome palette of orange adds warmth and drama to the depiction.

artworks.title: J.Barbey d'Aurevilly
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's head and shoulders at the center of the page. The man faces forward with his head slightly tilted to the left. He has a mustache and medium length curly or wavy hair. He wears a dark-colored garment that covers part of his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with an off-white or light cream color.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Baby
artworks.medium: crayon enlargement
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child seated on a chair. The child is positioned sitting, with the left leg slightly bent and supported by a cushion covered in dark green fabric. The child has light brown hair that is neatly combed back, light blue eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. They are wearing a long white dress with lace details along the collar, cuffs, and hem. Around their neck, the child wears a gold chain necklace with a pendant. The chair has an ornately carved dark wood frame, upholstered in deep red, tufted fabric with a pattern. The background is a soft blend of beige and dark tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Father and Daughter
artworks.medium: ambrotype
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an adult male and a young child. The man is seated, positioned slightly to the left of the frame, and is facing forward with a serious expression. His hair is dark and combed back with a widowed peak. He is wearing a coat over a collared shirt. Next to him, the young child is seated in front, facing the camera. The child's facial features are not clearly visible. The child is wearing a light-colored, patterned dress with puffed sleeves and appears to be holding something in their hands. Around the neck of the child, a necklace can be seen. The background is dark, emphasizing the figures in the foreground. The photograph is bordered with an oval frame.

artworks.title: Gazebo in the Forest Near Moscow
artworks.medium: silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a small, round structure with a thatched roof set in a forest. The building has columns supporting the roof, an ornate window with a geometric pattern, and a door with chevron designs. The forest surrounds the structure, obscuring the horizon. The photo is in black and white with high contrast, giving it an old and vintage look. The foreground includes some ground cover and the base of tall trees, with the building just beyond. The forest in the background adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Hampton Court (Second View)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverbank with a flowing river beside a village. The river reflects the sky and trees on the opposite bank. There are small boats moored on the left, with trees and a fence on the grassy bank. In the distance, there are buildings and a taller structure slightly to the right. The horizon is obscured by trees and buildings. The image has a monochromatic sepia tone, resembling an old photograph.

artworks.title: Windsor Lock
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with an elevated walkway on the right overlooking a stone-paved path leading to a house surrounded by trees. A reflective canal is lined with tall trees on the left, with a lock integrated into the structure. A young boy leans on the railings near us, looking over the water. The color palette is monochromatic with soft sepia tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The textures in the photograph convey a sense of stillness and quietude.
